summary_en: 16,185,205 shares to be cancelled (9.9% of shares outstanding ex-treasury). Effective 2026-09-18. Reason: to achieve TSE Prime Market listing maintenance standard for free-float ratio (target 33.6%+). Post-cancellation: 148,167,340 issued shares; 285,100 treasury shares remaining.
title_en: Notice regarding cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-31, Kosaido Holdings announced a board resolution to cancel 16,185,205 treasury shares, effective 2026-09-18. The cancellation represents 9.9% of shares outstanding (computed as 16,185,205 ÷ 164,352,545 ex-treasury shares at that measurement date). The stated reason is to achieve compliance with the TSE Prime Market listing maintenance standard requiring a free-float ratio of 33.6% or higher. As of 2026-03-31, the company's free-float ratio was 33.6%, meeting the target through this cancellation. Post-cancellation, issued shares will total 148,167,340 and treasury holdings will be 285,100 shares.
